tools.name: get_design_guide
tools.description: Returns Fillio's design reference for low-pressure overmolding of electronics (boards, connectors, cable junctions): when the process fits, resins, values to aim for, 3D file preparation, what the portal's analysis checks. Useful when designing or reviewing a part to be overmolded.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Returns as data what Fillio makes, the resins, the design values to aim for (size, resin volume and thickness, cables, draft), the accepted file formats and the body names it recognizes. Values are read from the analysis rules currently in force.

tools.name: get_upload_link
tools.description: Returns the address of Fillio's portal, where the user uploads a 3D file, gets the feasibility analysis and requests a quote, with the steps and what to have at hand. Read-only: nothing is created or sent.

tools.name: estimate_in_house_potting_cost
tools.description: Returns the real cost per working part of one year of in-house potting (epoxy or resin encapsulation), comparable with a quote: labour, engineering, rejects, returns, resin, curing space, equipment, health and safety, and delays. Same calculation as the calculator on www.fillio.ca; a missing argumen

tools.name: recommend_overmolding_resin
tools.description: Returns the low-pressure overmolding polyamide family best suited to a part's service temperatures, exposures, hardness and needs, with its service range, hardness, colours, what remains to confirm with Fillio and another compatible family. Same choices and same answer as the selector on www.fillio.

tools.name: recommend_3d_printing_resin
tools.description: Returns the SLA 3D printing resin best suited to a part's use, behaviour, service temperature and requirements, with its properties, the reasons for the choice, what remains to confirm and another option. Same choices and same answer as the selector on www.fillio.ca.

tools.name: get_part_check
tools.description: Returns the feasibility analysis of a part uploaded with start_part_check: the outcome, the points to revisit with their location in millimetres, what was checked without remark and the recognized role of each body. Pending while the analysis is running. Requires the same connected Fillio account.

Read-only: nothing is sent or saved. An answer left

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "start_part_check" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_harness_quote_template, submit_part_check · Private data: get_design_guide, get_capabilities, get_upload_link, send_harness_quote_template, start_part_check, get_submission_summary · Public sink: get_upload_link, send_harness_quote_template, start_part_check, get_submission_summary, submit_part_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_harness_quote_template, submit_part_check · Private data: get_design_guide, get_capabilities, get_upload_link, send_harness_quote_template, start_part_check, get_submission_summary · Public sink: get_upload_link, send_harness_quote_template, start_part_check, get_submission_summary, submit_part_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "send_harness_quote_template" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Returns a check of a wire harness connection list (unknown references, contacts beyond the number of positions, duplicate contacts or wires, connectors with no wire or no length) and what the project still needs for a quote, and emails Fillio's Excel quote request template, filled in with the projec" → after: "Returns a check of a wire harness connection list (unknown references, contacts beyond the number of positions, duplicate contacts or wires, connectors with no wire or no length) and what the project still needs for a quote, and writes to the given address: a confirmation email, then, once its recip"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
